name: in.productgrowth/productgrowth
title: productgrowth.in
description: India business numbers with sources, SaaS/AI tool prices in ₹, today's India tech brief. No key.

tools.name: ask_kriya
tools.description: Ask Kriyā, the productgrowth.in AI advisor for Indian startup founders and product managers: a written answer to an India business question (GST, RBI and SEBI rules, UPI and payments, funding, pricing in ₹, go-to-market in India) from India-specific sources, with the sources it cited. Without a key: 5 free answers a day. With a free Kriyā key (kriya_…, made at https://productgrowth.in/account/): up to 30 an hour. It does not remember earlier questions: put the context in the question.

question.description: The question, with whatever context Kriyā needs.

industry.description: Optional. Focus the answer on one industry. Default: general.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search the productgrowth.in tool directory (about 360 software tools used by Indian startups) by category, highest rupee price, free plan and India fit (bills in rupees, gives a GST invoice, takes UPI, keeps data in India). Returns each tool with its cheapest listed paid price in ₹, the date we checked it, its score out of 100 and the productgrowth.in page to cite. Read-only. Uses one call of your free Data API allowance.

query.description: Optional. Words to match in the tool's name or category, e.g. "crm" or "email".

max_price_inr.description: Optional. Highest cheapest-paid-plan price in rupees. Tools with no rupee price on record are left out when this is set; free tools count as ₹0.

free_plan.description: Optional. true = only tools with a free plan.

min_india_fit.description: Optional. How many of the four India checks must be a known yes: bills in rupees, GST invoice, UPI, data kept in India.

limit.description: Optional. How many tools to return (1–25, default 10). Best score first.

tools.name: tool_price
tools.description: The price of one software tool from the productgrowth.in directory: cheapest listed paid price in ₹ and how we got it (vendor lists rupees, or converted from dollars at the stated rate), whether it has a free plan, the date the price was checked, the vendor's pricing page, India fit, its score and recent price or plan changes. Read-only. Uses one call of your free Data API allowance.

slug.description: The tool's slug as productgrowth.in uses it (for example "hubspot", "zoho-crm"), or its name.

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: Price and plan changes productgrowth.in saw on software vendors' own pricing and changelog pages since a date, newest first: the date, the tool, what changed (old and new line where we have them) and the vendor page it was read on. Read-only. Uses one call of your free Data API allowance.

since.description: A date like 2026-11-01. Changes on or after it.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two or three tools from the productgrowth.in directory side by side: rupee price and how we got it, free plan, India fit (rupees, GST invoice, UPI, data in India), score, date checked and the pages to cite. Read-only. Uses one call of your free Data API allowance.

items.description: The tool's slug as productgrowth.in uses it (for example "hubspot", "zoho-crm"), or its name.

slugs.description: Two or three tool slugs or names.

tools.name: today_brief
tools.description: Today's India tech and startup brief from productgrowth.in: the day's stories (funding, regulation, payments, AI, SaaS) with a short summary, why it matters for builders, the original source link and our page for each story. Use it for "what happened in Indian tech today". Free, no key.

tools.name: numbers_lookup
tools.description: India business and economy numbers with sources from the productgrowth.in Numbers page: UPI volumes and value, card spends, mutual fund AUM, inflation, GST collections, internet users and similar. Each figure comes with its source, source link, "as of" date and when it was last verified. Use it when you need a citable Indian figure. Free, no key.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "upi transactions" or "credit card spends".

tools.name: search_productgrowth
tools.description: Search productgrowth.in pages: Indian SaaS/AI tool pages with ₹ prices, "X vs Y" tool comparisons, India numbers, articles, prompts and resources. Returns only pages that exist, with their links. Use section "compare" for tool comparisons, "tools" for tool pages, "numbers" for figures. Free, no key.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "zoho vs hubspot" or "cursor pricing".

section.description: Optional. Limit to one section. Default: all.
